lines.text: In November 2026, Apple listed a refurbished iPad mini (A17 Pro) at $509, versus $599 new.
lines.say: In November twenty twenty-six, Apple listed a refurbished iPad mini at five oh nine dollars, versus five ninety-nine new.

lines.text: Our math: $90 saved, and 90 divided by 599 is about 15%.
lines.say: Our math: ninety dollars saved, and ninety divided by five ninety-nine is about fifteen percent.

lines.text: Apple says its refurbished iPhones come with a new battery and a new outer shell.
lines.say: Apple says its refurbished iPhones come with a new battery and a new outer shell.

lines.text: Labels vary, though. Refurbished means repaired and tested, used is sold as-is, and open-box is a return.

lines.text: The world made 62 million metric tons of e-waste in 2022; only about 22% was documented recycled.

lines.text: So the face-off comes down to three things: who fixed it, the warranty, and the battery.
